text: The doctor is lovely and gentle, but the plump, dark-skinned front desk staff member was impolite in tone, demeanor, and gaze. Working with children requires more gentleness. When weighing a child or laying them down for height measurement, she acted as if she disliked the child, gesturing for the mother to step back as if dismissing them. Her hand movements were dismissive, as if she had never worked in a front desk position before. Even if she's experienced, such behavior isn't acceptable. Every time I bring my child for vaccinations, because I admire and trust the doctor, I always have a negative experience with this staff member. I would like the doctor to send her staff for personality training to improve future service.
The doctor provides excellent and friendly service. Generations of my children and grandchildren have all been brought here for treatment.

Dr. Chan is skilled, the medicine is good, and the clinic has lots of toys that the kids love. However, some of the staff often look grumpy towards me, and I don't know why. They speak nicely and normally to others.
The doctor was kind and gave good advice...but the front desk staff were terrible. It was a very poor service experience. They are not suitable for customer service jobs.
